spec.title: TrueNAS · Mission Control
spec.description: Flagship TrueNAS SCALE dashboard fed by the truenas-scale-api-prometheus-exporter. Tabs group the full metric surface by operational concern; the Overview tab is the 30-second health check. Generated by build_mission_control.py.

links.title: Operations Center (classic)
links.tooltip: Open the original TrueNAS Operations Center dashboard

spec.title: Pools
spec.description: Worst pool health across all ZFS pools.

spec.title: Pool Capacity
spec.description: Allocated share of total pool space.

spec.title: ARC Data Hit
spec.description: ZFS ARC demand-data hit ratio (computed from hit/miss counters).

spec.title: Update
spec.description: Whether a TrueNAS update is available.

spec.title: Pool Utilization
spec.description: Allocated percentage per ZFS pool against real capacity.

spec.expr: 100 * max by (pool) (truenas_pool_allocated_bytes{instance=~"$instance", pool=~"$pool"}) / clamp_min(max by (pool) (truenas_pool_size_bytes{instance=~"$instance", pool=~"$pool"}), 1)

spec.title: Alerts by Level
spec.description: Current alert distribution by severity level.

spec.title: Load per Core
spec.description: Load average normalized by CPU core count. 100% means the run queue equals the core count; the dashed line marks that saturation point.

spec.title: CPU Usage
spec.description: Total and per-core CPU usage. TrueNAS 25.10 no longer reports CPU mode splits.

spec.title: Memory & ZFS ARC
spec.description: Physical memory used vs total, with the ZFS ARC share.

spec.title: CPU Usage
spec.description: Total and per-core CPU usage. TrueNAS 25.10 no longer reports CPU mode splits.

spec.title: Load Average
spec.description: Load average vs CPU core count. Load above core count means queueing.

spec.title: Per-Core CPU Usage
spec.description: Per-core utilization. Helps identify single-threaded bottlenecks.

spec.title: CPU Temperature per Core
spec.description: Per-core CPU temperatures. Sustained high temps indicate cooling issues.

spec.title: ARC Free Memory
spec.description: Memory the documented realtime event reports as free to the ZFS ARC.

spec.title: RAM Used %
spec.description: Derived from documented physical-memory total and available values.

spec.title: Documented Memory Capacity Over Time
spec.description: Physical memory fields explicitly documented by reporting.realtime; used is total minus available.

spec.title: Documented ARC Memory Over Time
spec.description: ARC memory fields explicitly documented by reporting.realtime.

spec.title: Oldest Snap
spec.description: Age of the oldest snapshot. Very old snapshots may waste space.

spec.title: Pool Utilization
spec.description: Per-pool fill ratio. Pools above 80% suffer performance degradation.

spec.title: Top Dataset Utilization
spec.description: Datasets closest to filling their available space.

spec.title: Pool Capacity Trends
spec.description: Pool allocated and free space over time for capacity planning.

spec.title: Pool Fragmentation
spec.description: Pool fragmentation over time. High fragmentation degrades performance.

spec.title: Pool Scan Progress
spec.description: Active scrub or resilver progress per pool.

spec.title: Pool Inventory
spec.description: Pool capacity, health, dedup-table footprint, and active expansion progress.

spec.expr: 100 * max by (pool) (truenas_pool_allocated_bytes{instance=~"$instance", pool=~"$pool"}) / clamp_min(max by (pool) (truenas_pool_size_bytes{instance=~"$instance", pool=~"$pool"}), 1)

spec.title: Pool Expansion Progress
spec.description: Completion percentage for active pool expansion reflow.

spec.title: ARC Size
spec.description: Current documented ZFS ARC cache size.

spec.title: L2ARC Hit %
spec.description: L2ARC hit ratio. Shows 0% when no L2ARC device exists.

spec.title: Demand Hit & Miss Rates
spec.description: Documented ARC demand-data and demand-metadata hit and miss rates.

spec.title: ARC Memory Headroom
spec.description: Documented ARC free and available memory fields.

spec.title: Demand & L2ARC Hit Ratios
spec.description: Cache hit ratios — higher is better.

spec.title: Demand Data & Metadata Rates
spec.description: Demand access rates for data and metadata.

spec.title: L2ARC Throughput
spec.description: L2ARC I/O. High write with low hit ratio signals cache churn.

spec.title: Datasets Using Snapshot Space
spec.description: Datasets consuming the most space in snapshots.

spec.title: Dataset Capacity Detail
spec.description: Detailed dataset capacity, encryption, quota, and snapshot info.

spec.expr: 100 * max by (dataset) (truenas_dataset_used_bytes{instance=~"$instance", dataset=~"$dataset"}) / clamp_min(max by (dataset) (truenas_dataset_used_bytes{instance=~"$instance", dataset=~"$dataset"}) + max by (dataset) (truenas_dataset_available_bytes{instance=~"$instance", dataset=~"$dataset"}), 1)

spec.title: Dataset Policy Detail
spec.description: Dataset encryption, policy flags, quota thresholds, and age.

spec.title: Disk Throughput by Device
spec.description: Read/write throughput for the busiest devices.

spec.title: Disk Inventory
spec.description: Per-disk capacity, performance, temperature, and media type.

spec.title: GPU Host Avail
spec.description: GPUs available to the TrueNAS host.

spec.title: ImmediateData
spec.description: Active iSCSI sessions with immediate-data enabled.

spec.title: Used Disks
spec.description: Disks currently in use by pools.

spec.title: Service Inventory
spec.description: Service runtime state and boot enablement.

spec.title: DH RL Error
spec.description: DockerHub rate-limit endpoint currently reports an error.

spec.title: DockerHub Rem
spec.description: DockerHub pull requests remaining in current window.

spec.title: DockerHub Limit
spec.description: DockerHub pull limit window total requests.

spec.title: DH Window Left
spec.description: Seconds remaining in the current DockerHub pull-limit window.

spec.title: App Upgrades
spec.description: Apps with a newer chart or package version available.

spec.title: Migrated Apps
spec.description: Apps migrated from the older Kubernetes stack.

spec.title: Img Updates
spec.description: Apps with container image updates available.

spec.title: App Block I/O Rate
spec.description: Read/write throughput per app (rate of cumulative counters).

spec.title: Apps by Container Count
spec.description: Apps with the largest active workload footprint.

spec.title: App State Distribution
spec.description: Current state mix across installed apps.

spec.title: App Container State Distribution
spec.description: Current runtime state mix across app containers.

spec.title: App Inventory
spec.description: App resource footprint, update posture, and exposure summary.

spec.title: AMD ASIDs
spec.description: AMD Address Space Identifiers are supported.

spec.title: VM Memory Allocation
spec.description: VM memory available vs in use.

spec.title: Abortable
spec.description: Active jobs that can be cancelled.

spec.title: Last Alert Activity
spec.description: Age since the most recent alert occurrence.

spec.title: Running Job Progress
spec.description: Progress of currently running jobs by method.

spec.title: Active Jobs by State
spec.description: Current active job counts split by WAITING and RUNNING state.

spec.title: Oldest Active Job Age
spec.description: Age of the oldest active job in each state.

spec.title: Job Method Detail
spec.description: Active job counts and progress by middleware method.

spec.title: Alert Source and Node Detail
spec.description: Current alert counts grouped by source and by node.

spec.title: Task Enablement Detail
spec.description: Task enablement from documented task query fields.

spec.title: Dir Faults
spec.description: Enabled directory services reporting a fault.

spec.title: FIPS Avail
spec.description: FIPS capability is available on this system.

spec.expr: label_replace(max(truenas_local_user_count{instance=~"$instance"}), "category", "Local Users", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max(truenas_local_group_count{instance=~"$instance"}), "category", "Local Groups", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max(truenas_certificate_count{instance=~"$instance"}), "category", "Certificates", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max(truenas_privilege_count{instance=~"$instance"}), "category", "Privileges", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max(truenas_keychain_credential_count{instance=~"$instance"}), "category", "Keychain Creds", "__name__", ".*")

spec.title: Certificate Expiry
spec.description: Certificate expiry in operator-friendly relative and absolute forms.

spec.title: Activated BEs
spec.description: Boot environments selected for the next boot.

spec.title: Boot Environment Used Space
spec.description: Bytes used by each boot environment.

spec.title: Oldest Alert Age
spec.description: Age of the oldest active alert.

spec.title: Boot Env Next
spec.description: Boot environments selected for the next boot.

spec.title: Demand Access/s
spec.description: Total ARC demand accesses per second.

spec.title: Advanced ZFS Ratios
spec.description: Advanced ARC/L2ARC percentage metrics from realtime telemetry.

spec.title: Advanced ZFS Access & Miss Rates
spec.description: Advanced demand and L2ARC activity rates.

spec.title: Exporter Version
spec.description: Exporter build version label currently active per instance.

spec.title: Boot Environment Flags
spec.description: Current, next-boot, and retention flags for rollback planning.

spec.title: API Method Detail
spec.description: Per-method duration, success flag, and errors.
